description: API lifecycle policy. Deprecated routes must not be used by frontend code or reintroduced on the server unless explicitly documented here.

canonicalReferenceRoutes.reason: Home bootstrap is the preferred aggregated reference-data endpoint for initial home loads. Keep narrower reference endpoints only when callers explicitly need partial refreshes.

canonicalFeedRoutes.reason: Use this route for homepage feed tabs because it centralizes feed kind handling and homepage cache semantics.

canonicalFor: country or location filtered post list
canonicalFeedRoutes.reason: Keep this route for generic post listings outside the home feed surface. Do not add another generic post-list endpoint.

deprecatedRoutes.reason: Collapsed duplicate admin chat list endpoint; frontend uses the canonical /api/admin/chat endpoint.

publicWriteRoutePrefixes.reason: Authentication endpoints intentionally accept public login/register/logout requests and apply dedicated rate limiting or session handling.
Webhook endpoints are authenticated by provider-specific signatures instead of user sessions.
